summary: New curvilinear meniscus-shaped opacity at the left costophrenic angle/lateral chest wall on current not present on prior, consistent with new/increased left pleural effusion; right basilar opacity appears similarly dense on both and is not marked.

findings.rationale: Prior shows a relatively clear left costophrenic angle below the cardiac silhouette; current shows a new curved meniscus of opacity sweeping from the lateral chest wall up toward the mediastinum on the left, matched using the same rib/diaphragm landmarks. Portable AP technique, patient rotation, and overlapping support lines limit certainty.
